verdict: There is one clear call to action, but the path to it is long.

findings.title: Buttons use vague labels
findings.issue: Three buttons say "Learn more" and none says what happens next.
findings.impact_text: Visitors hesitate when a button does not promise an outcome.
findings.fix: Rename the primary button to "Book a discovery call" and keep the label consistent.
findings.evidence: Click-through on the primary button was measured at 1.2% in the sample data.

findings.title: Contact form asks for nine fields
findings.issue: The form asks for budget, timeline and phone before a name.
findings.fix: Cut the form to name, email and one open question.

strengths: The primary action is visible on load
